title: Unit Event — Cheer With My Heart! — Episode1 A Gathering of Idols

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! has received an invitation to the Lumina Grand Prix, an idol TV program organized by Ms. Arisawa. At the orientation, the legendary idol speaks of the idea of a "true idol", which resonates with Airi.

rows.Line: Event Venue
se_run_women_002_1

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line:
Thank you all for your patience!
I've finished registering us, so let's make our way inside.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you for taking care of that, Saito.

rows.Speaker: Saito
rows.Line: Not a problem! Still, this orientation event is bigger than I was anticipating...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Same here. I'm seeing a lot of reporters and photographers, not just the idols and staff.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I guess it means the Lumina Grand Prix is just that big a deal.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
Look, it's...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is that Arisa...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see... The members of ReLight and Cheerful * Days are also here.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. That was probably to be expected, but...
Good morning, everyone!!!
I'm Hikarin, the biggest idol in the galaxy☆ My smile has the power to brighten up the entire universe!

rows.Speaker: Hikarin
rows.Line: All you reporters out there better get pictures of me now, because I might just end up this competition's dark-horse winner!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Is she new? It's nice how peppy she is.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: D-Do you think we should introduce ourselves like that too...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No need for that, so try to calm down.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(There really are all sorts of different idols here...
Some from the underground scene, and plenty of others I'm seeing for the first time. They're all unique, from their personalities to their experience level.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (The only thing we all have in common is that we were sent invitations by Ms. Arisawa...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, your true identity is the legendary idol, Hinako Arisawa...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And you're organizing a program called the Lumina Grand Prix...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (“A program that decides who the best idols are.”)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (In other words, we'd be competing against other idols to see who's number one.)

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: I apologize if I startled all of you.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: But I'd appreciate it very much if you all attended the orientation session and heard more.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Orientation?

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Yes. It should give MORE MORE JUMP! a chance to see whether or not this program's goals align with your own.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: I'd like for you to have that opportunity before you make a decision.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Our goal as a group is to spread more hope than anyone else...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (We've been doing everything we can up until now to make that happen.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (While that's led to offers trickling back in, there's no denying that we're still in a tough spot...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (So, we need to see if this is our opportunity to turn things around.)

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Thank you all for being here today.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: My name is Hinako Arisawa, and I'm the organizer of this program. I hope this orientation proves fruitful for you all.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Ms. Arisawa...!

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: At any rate, I'll jump right in by explaining what the Lumina Grand Prix is all about.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: The overall concept is “a program that decides who the best idols are.”

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: I'm sure many of you are here today because you were drawn to that thought.

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: As a television program, the Lumina Grand Prix is a competition between idols all striving for the top...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: But that's all set up for the viewers' entertainment. It is not the true goal of this program.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (What?)

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Before we move to the finer details, I'd like to first discuss why I decided to create this program...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: Through this competition...

rows.Speaker: Arisawa
rows.Line: I'm hoping to bring out the “true idols” in each of you. For everyone in the country... No, for everyone around the world to see.
